cases.question: Why does the model use CAMS as an input if CAMS is wrong?
cases.answer: Even though CAMS can be inaccurate on its own (with an overall CAMS MAE of 8.291 compared to the live overall MAE of 4.787), it provides valuable large-scale atmospheric signals that our model corrects and improves upon. The backtest accuracy shows that our model achieves a mean skill vs CAMS of 0.407, and live track records demonstrate a skill vs CAMS of 0.423 overall. By using CAMS as a baseline feature alongside other inputs, the system successfully filters out its errors to deliver a much more accurate forecast.
